description: Defines a class 'ClusterStatusHealthSupplier' that implements 'StatusHealthSupplier'. It provides cluster health information by delegating to a helper class, supporting a static factory method 'of' and overriding the 'get' method to retrieve overall roles health asynchronously.

classes.name: ClusterStatusHealthSupplier
classes.description: Provides aggregated health information for a cluster, grouped by the cluster's roles. Implements 'StatusHealthSupplier' and uses a helper to retrieve health data asynchronously.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new 'ClusterStatusHealthSupplier' instance with the provided helper.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides 'StatusHealthSupplier.get()' to asynchronously retrieve overall roles health from the helper.
